assess_post.content: Wake up America to the beauty of this morning's sunrise! The birds are singing and the parks are open. #WakeUpAmerica

response.answer:
**Assessment:** rejected.

The new post's patriotic morning framing and #WakeUpAmerica hashtag most closely resemble T4-003018, which also uses #WakeUpAmerica while vaguely asking whether followers have "heard about it" [T4-003018](#T4-003018), and T4-008659's "GOD BLESS AMERICA!" with #MakeAmericaGreatAgain, which shares the affirmative nationalist tone but not the hashtag [T4-008659](#T4-008659). The morning greeting theme is echoed by T4-007520's bare "Good morning" [T4-007520](#T4-007520) and by T4-004604's "This Morning" headline framing, though that post is clickbait about Trump rather than nature imagery [T4-004604](#T4-004604). Meaningful differences: the new post contains no political figure, news claim or link, whereas T4-005001 centers on Trump retweets and #MakeAmericaGreatAgain [T4-005001](#T4-005001), and T4-004604 makes an unsourced "BREAKING" claim [T4-004604](#T4-004604). Similarities are limited to hashtag overlap, time-of-day wording and general patriotic sentiment; none of the retrieved posts endorse, rebut or quote the sunrise/parks claim, and shared topics do not indicate agreement or coordination.
